name: Favor Servant
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target antipaladin’s fiendish servant
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw yes (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You infuse your fiendish servant with divine vigor. Your fiendish servant receives a +2 luck bonus to attack rolls and receives the benefit of the bull’s strength and bear’s endurance spells. These effects are not shared with you, and this spell can be used only on your fiendish servant.
